afa6c0c6c931.title: Graduate Management Trainee - London
afa6c0c6c931.description:
Overview 
 We’re Enterprise Mobility. A family-owned, global mobility leader with a $39 billion turnover, nearly 90,000 team members, and operations in 95 countries. Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we’re built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long-term success of our people, our customers and our business.
 Join us, and as a three-time TargetJobs Graduate Employer of the Year and a The Times Top 100 Graduate Employer, we’ll give you the freedom to explore your potential – and the support to shape your own career journey. Ready to make your move?
 Why join the Graduate Management Training Programme? 
 As a Graduate Management Trainee, you'll have the freedom and support to explore your leadership potential - and the opportunity to become a branch manager in one of our retail operations in as little as two years. In fact, most of our senior leaders began their careers in this very role - including our current CEO.
 From day one, we’ll invest in you. You’ll be in a supportive environment where you’ll take on real responsibilities and gain invaluable hands-on experience in customer service, sales, marketing, finance, operations, and more.
 We work hard and reward hard work 
 Your work will be recognised with performance-based incentives and opportunities for continued promotion. Our unique promote-from-within culture means you can keep your career moving forward without having to change organisations.
 Award-winning training and development 
 Whether you’re building on existing strengths or developing new ones, your growth is our priority. Through classroom learning, on-the-job training, and mentorship, you’ll have the tools and support to take the next step – and the one after that.
 Our doors are open 
 As a Graduate Management Trainee, your experience at Enterprise Mobility will be as unique as you because you shape who we are as much as we shape your skills, path and potential. We pride ourselves on opening our doors to a variety of voices, giving way to an experience that’s both inclusive and that inspires diversity of thought.
 Responsibilities 
 From your very first day, you’ll be trusted with real responsibility and exposed to all areas of our business. You’ll develop skills in:
 Customer Service: deliver exceptional experiences by confidently handling reservations, resolving enquiries, and building rapport with a diverse range of customers.
 Sales and Marketing: connect with local business partners, grow your network and develop lasting relationships.
 Financial Control and Profitability: understand the financial mechanics of a successful business, including cost control and interpreting profit and loss statements.
 Operations and Logistics: learn how to manage a fleet, plan strategically, and drive performance.
 Leadership and Development: take the lead in mentoring, training, and developing your own team - with the opportunity to manage and promote others as you grow. 
 Qualifications 
 A Bachelor’s degree is preferred; however, professional experience can be substituted if applicable. 
 You must have a full manual UK or EU driving licence, but we do make accommodations for applicants who don’t drive due to a disability. 
 No drug or alcohol related offence on driving record within the last five years is permitted. 
 Additional Information 
 Regardless of your socio-economic background, university attended, subject studied, and degree attained, we will always look at how you perform against our competencies and will judge you on that alone.
 In accordance with current government guidelines, we are unable to offer sponsorship for this role as the role does not appear on the Home Office list of RQF Level 6 roles approved for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker system.
 Please let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in our recruitment process.
 Please limit your application to only one job posting based on where you live and/or plan to work. Applying to multiple locations will delay your application being processed. 
 This job posting is for applications within the following location(s): London

Overview 
 We’re Enterprise Mobility. A family-owned, global mobility leader with a $39 billion turnover, nearly 90,000 team members, and operations in 95 countries. Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we’re built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long-term success of our people, our customers and our business.
 Join us, and as a three-time TargetJobs Graduate Employer of the Year and a The Times Top 100 Graduate Employer, we’ll give you the freedom to explore your potential – and the support to shape your own career journey. Ready to make your move?
 Why join the Graduate Management Training Programme? 
 As a Graduate Management Trainee, you'll have the freedom and support to explore your leadership potential - and the opportunity to become a branch manager in one of our retail operations in as little as two years. In fact, most of our senior leaders began their careers in this very role - including our current CEO.
 From day one, we’ll invest in you. You’ll be in a supportive environment where you’ll take on real responsibilities and gain invaluable hands-on experience in customer service, sales, marketing, finance, operations, and more.
 We work hard and reward hard work 
 Your work will be recognised with performance-based incentives and opportunities for continued promotion. Our unique promote-from-within culture means you can keep your career moving forward without having to change organisations.
 Award-winning training and development 
 Whether you’re building on existing strengths or developing new ones, your growth is our priority. Through classroom learning, on-the-job training, and mentorship, you’ll have the tools and support to take the next step – and the one after that.
 Our doors are open 
 As a Graduate Management Trainee, your experience at Enterprise Mobility will be as unique as you because you shape who we are as much as we shape your skills, path and potential. We pride ourselves on opening our doors to a variety of voices, giving way to an experience that’s both inclusive and that inspires diversity of thought.
 Responsibilities 
 From your very first day, you’ll be trusted with real responsibility and exposed to all areas of our business. You’ll develop skills in:
 Customer Service: deliver exceptional experiences by confidently handling reservations, resolving enquiries, and building rapport with a diverse range of customers.
 Sales and Marketing: connect with local business partners, grow your network and develop lasting relationships.
 Financial Control and Profitability: understand the financial mechanics of a successful business, including cost control and interpreting profit and loss statements.
 Operations and Logistics: learn how to manage a fleet, plan strategically, and drive performance.
 Leadership and Development: take the lead in mentoring, training, and developing your own team - with the opportunity to manage and promote others as you grow. 
 Qualifications 
 A Bachelor’s degree is preferred; however, professional experience can be substituted if applicable. 
 You must have a full manual UK or EU driving licence, but we do make accommodations for applicants who don’t drive due to a disability. 
 No drug or alcohol related offence on driving record within the last five years is permitted. 
 Additional Information 
 Regardless of your socio-economic background, university attended, subject studied, and degree attained, we will always look at how you perform against our competencies and will judge you on that alone.
 In accordance with current government guidelines, we are unable to offer sponsorship for this role as the role does not appear on the Home Office list of RQF Level 6 roles approved for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker system.
 Please let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in our recruitment process.
 Please limit your application to only one job posting based on where you live and/or plan to work. Applying to multiple locations will delay your application being processed.

About Man Group 
 Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. Powered by talent and advanced technology, our single and multi-manager investment strategies are underpinned by deep research and span public and private markets, across all major asset classes, with a significant focus on alternatives. Man Group takes a partnership approach to working with clients, establishing deep connections and creating tailored solutions to meet their investment goals and those of the millions of retirees and savers they represent.
 Headquartered in London, we manage $253.6 billion* and operate across multiple offices globally. Man Group plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker EMG.LN and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. Further information can be found at 
 At Man Group, we respect your privacy and we are committed to protecting and safeguarding your Personal Data. We have developed policies and processes which are designed to provide for the security and integrity of your Personal Data. We are committed to Processing your Personal Data fairly and lawfully, and being open and transparent about such Processing. For further information on how we process your data, please see the privacy notice for applicants 
 * As at 30 June 2026
 Investment Risk – Summer 2027 Internship 
 Systematic Investment Risk team sits at the heart of Man Group's systematic investment process, providing independent oversight of the risk profile of our trading strategies and funds. Working closely with portfolio managers, researchers, and technologists, the team ensures that risk is well understood, appropriately managed, and consistently reflected in how we allocate capital and construct portfolios.
 This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to a fast-paced, quantitatively driven environment at the intersection of markets, mathematics, and technology. Interns will work alongside experienced risk professionals on real problems affecting live trading strategies, from day-to-day risk monitoring to longer-term projects enhancing our internal risk models and analytical tools. It's an excellent grounding for anyone interested in a career in quantitative finance and risk management.
 Key responsibilities :
 Monitor and manage risk across systematic trading strategies & funds
 Work with all areas within the business – both within and outside Systematic – to resolve risk issues as they arise
 Assist in building out the broader risk framework and analytical infrastructure – including internal risk models and code
 Conduct research into new risk measurement and management techniques
 Required skills :
 A strong mathematical and statistical background
 Excellent communication skills
 Currently in your penultimate year of study, graduating in 2028
 Learning opportunities :
 A broad understanding of the full range of Man Systematic trading strategies
 Technical familiarity with both industry-standard and proprietary internal risk analytics & modelling techniques
 Knowledge of financial markets across all major asset classes
 Application Process 
 Application Window: 28th September - 12th October 2026
 Online Tests: October
 Technical Interviews: October/November
 Assessment Centre: November/December– Please note that candidates will be required to attend the assessment centre at our London Office.
 Programme Dates: 21st June 2027 – 10th September 2027 
 Inclusion, Work-Life Balance and Benefits at Man Group 
You'll thrive in our working environment that champions equality of opportunity. Your unique perspective will contribute to our success, joining a workplace where inclusion is fundamental and deeply embedded in our culture and values. Through our external and internal initiatives, partnerships and programmes, you'll find opportunities to grow, develop your talents, and help foster an inclusive environment for all across our firm and industry. Learn more at .
You'll have opportunities to make a difference through our charitable and global initiatives, while advancing your career through professional development, and with flexible working arrangements available too. Like all our people, you'll receive two annual 'Mankind' days of paid leave for community volunteering.
 Our comprehensive benefits package includes competitive holiday entitlements, pension/401k, life and long-term disability coverage, group sick pay, enhanced parental leave and long-service leave. Depending on your location, you may also enjoy additional benefits such as private medical coverage, discounted gym membership options and pet insurance.

Global Wealth, Summer Internship (8 weeks) 
(PGIM Global Wealth, London) 
 A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE 
As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we're always looking for ways to improve financial services. We're passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. 
We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you'll unlock a motivating and impactful career - all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world's leading global asset managers! 
If you're not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that's investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. 
At PGIM, You Can! 
 What you will do 
As an intern within the UK Distribution team, you will support live business initiatives across market research, client engagement and business development, helping the team identify commercial opportunities, analyse industry trends and deliver investment solutions across public and private markets. 
Working alongside senior sales leaders, investment professionals and product specialists, you will contribute to strategic projects, help prepare for client interactions and develop insights into the investment landscape. 
 What you can expect 
During this 8-week internship, you will gain first-hand experience of how a leading global asset manager develops relationships with wealth managers, private banks, family offices and financial advisers. You will work directly with senior sales leaders and investment teams, helping to identify business opportunities, deliver market insights and support strategic client relationships. 
The programme is designed to provide meaningful responsibility from day one, culminating in the presentation of a strategic growth opportunity or market-based research project to senior business leaders. 
 What you will bring 
 Desire to gain first-hand experience of asset management/fund distribution industry.
 Strong written, oral communication, and interpersonal skills.
 Ability to work well independently and seamlessly within a team environment.
 A can-do attitude with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
 Proficient in Microsoft Office products. 
 Candidates must have the right to work in the UK
 *PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. 
 About Global Wealth 
Global Wealth provides access to active investment strategies across the global markets in the pursuit of consistent outperformance for investors. We're part of PGIM, a leading global investment manager. 
Global Wealth offers actively managed investment solutions including US mutual funds; closed-end funds; ETFs; UCITS funds; PGIM Custom Harvest; and Asia Local. 
Our broad range of investment solutions allows us to deliver a diversified suite of actively managed solutions across a broad spectrum of asset classes and investment styles to meet investors' long-term needs. We are intentional about creating a workplace where everyone has a voice and is welcomed, valued, respected and understood. From the moment people join PGIM, we pledge to help them unlock their full potential. Together, we are shaping a future where talent knows no boundaries.

ION is the world’s most progressive FinTech company providing pioneering software and consultancy services to customers around the globe. We serve large financial institutions, trading firms, central banks, and corporations. We are committed to automating processes that positively impact our customers’ work and provide insights to enable more informed decision making. Our products and services help the world's leading organizations do more, in a better and simpler way than ever before. 
ION software underpins the global fixed income, foreign exchange, and derivatives markets, powers the world’s central banks, and manages cash and risk for thousands of companies worldwide. ION data and analytics are the golden source for M&A, equity, and leverage finance bankers worldwide. With a dynamic team of 13,000+ employees, in 50+ global offices, and 5,000+ customers worldwide, ION provides an unparalleled career experience for those who share our passion for growth and technology evolution.

ION Analytics: Provider of investment banking M&A, equity and debt data, analytics, and content.

ION Markets: Provider of workflow solutions that automate the complete trade lifecycle and deliver actionable insights in real-time.
ION Treasury: Provider of unique treasury and risk management solutions that help clients manage liquidity of any scale while mitigating operational, financial, and reputational risk. 
 
Our Programme
Our Leadership Development Program (LDP) is a foundational global initiative focused on developing talent for ION’s growing operations around the world. The program provides an opportunity for outstanding college graduates to start a career in a dynamic and fast paced global FinTech firm. 
Analysts will spend the first 18 months of their career in 3 unique, 6-month rotations covering a broad range of ION's core capabilities. At the end of their 3 rotations analysts will transition to a deeper dive in one area of ION. 
Sample rotations/deep dives include:
Product Strategy
Product Management
Business Intelligence and Data Analytics
Product Implementation Services
Consulting and Delivery Services
Sales and Account Management
Corporate Development
Project Management 
Leadership Development Program Analysts will explore various roles across multiple ION divisions. LDP is available in New York, Chicago, Houston, Toronto, Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, and London. 
Analysts will spend their first rotation filling a business need in their home office. However, analysts mayhave the opportunity to spend their second or third rotations in another location. 
 
What you'll do
 
As an LDP, you will be working at the forefront of the FinTech industry in teams with fellow analysts and experienced subject matter experts. After going through our thorough induction program, you will quickly be expected to take ownership of challenging projects that make a real difference to our company and our customers. You will gain exposure and extensive skills related to the different areas of ION's capabilities. Throughout the program you will also be encouraged to pursue interests and skills outside of your rotation to further yourself and the organization.
 
Highlighted Analyst Projects


 Application process & deadline
 
Applicants that submit successful online applications will be required to complete online verbal and numerical reasoning assessments within 4 days of receiving the test link.
 
Successful applicants will subsequently be invited to a video interview.
 
The final part of the process is an assessment day consisting of interviews, a case study and a group exercise.
 
We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as you are ready because initial video interviews can occur prior to the application period closing.
 
We aim to notify you of your application status approximately one month after we receive your application.

76946dd71734.title: Sales Development Representative - January 2027 Intake
76946dd71734.description:
Techary redefines the way customers procure, implement, and support their organisations' technology, providing an innovative alternative to the traditional Managed Service Provider (MSP) / Value-Added Reseller (VAR) approach. 
 Our concept, “Technology, done differently”, embodies our belief that the way our customers consume and utilize technology should innovate at the same pace as the technology itself.
 Our customers range from small start-ups to global enterprises. From designing, deploying and managing infrastructure stacks within low-latency financial trading environments, to relocating the headquarters of a global fintech firm, our operations span multiple markets, industries and geographies.
 Techary have helped customers scale their operations globally, gain an advantage in financial markets, enabled mission-critical projects and, most importantly, implemented technology that delivers alpha-accelerating business transformation.
 The Role 
 We are looking for ambitious and commercially minded Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to join Techary as part of our January 2027 intake.
 Techary is a fast-growing global technology business, working with customers ranging from ambitious scale-ups to some of the world’s largest financial services and enterprise organisations. With teams across the UK, US, Europe and Asia, we are continuing to invest in our sales function as we scale globally.
 As an SDR, you will be at the front end of that growth, focused on identifying new opportunities, building relationships and opening doors into large enterprise organisations.
 You will learn how to break into complex accounts, identify the people who influence technology decisions and create opportunities with organisations that may never have engaged with Techary before.
 Using a combination of cold calling, email, networking and intelligent account research, you will identify target organisations, understand their technology environment and engage senior decision-makers in meaningful commercial conversations.
 This is not simply about generating activity or booking meetings. We want our SDRs to understand why they are targeting an organisation, who they should be speaking to and what could create a genuine opportunity for Techary.
 You do not need previous enterprise or technology sales experience. We will provide structured training, tools, coaching and hands-on exposure to help you develop. What matters most is your ambition, resilience, curiosity, coachability and confidence to start conversations with new people.
 You will join alongside other SDRs as part of our January 2027 intake, developing together while building your own pipeline, target accounts and commercial experience.
 For the right person, this is the starting point for a long-term career in technology sales, with a clear progression path from Sales Development Representative to Associate Account Manager and ultimately Account Manager.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Proactively identify and engage prospective customers through cold calling, email, networking and events.
 Research high-value target organisations and identify potential opportunities for Techary.
 Build an understanding of target accounts, including their business, technology environment, key stakeholders and potential challenges.
 Identify and engage relevant decision-makers and senior stakeholders.
 Generate qualified new business meetings and opportunities through a thoughtful, multi-channel prospecting approach.
 Conduct initial conversations with prospects to understand their environment, challenges and potential requirements.
 Qualify opportunities to establish whether there is a genuine commercial fit for Techary.
 Develop a strong understanding of Techary’s services, solutions, partners and value proposition.
 Work closely with Account Managers and the wider sales team on target accounts, messaging and new business priorities.
 Maintain accurate records of activity, conversations and opportunities within Salesforce.
 Consistently work towards and exceed individual and team targets.
 Take an active role in sales training, call coaching, roleplays and development sessions.
 Represent Techary professionally when engaging prospective customers.
 What You Will Learn 
 We want this role to be about much more than learning how to book meetings.
 You will receive structured development designed to give you the foundations for a successful career in enterprise technology sales, including how to:
 Research and understand complex organisations and their technology environments.
 Break into enterprise accounts and identify the right stakeholders.
 Cold call confidently and create conversations from scratch.
 Write effective and personalised prospecting emails.
 Run structured discovery conversations and ask effective commercial questions.
 Understand customer challenges and identify genuine sales opportunities.
 Qualify opportunities using recognised sales methodologies and frameworks.
 Build a working knowledge of Techary’s technology solutions and services.
 Understand how opportunities progress through a complete B2B sales cycle.
 Develop commercial awareness around pricing, margin and opportunity value.
 Use Salesforce, Lusha, power diallers and other sales tools effectively.
 Communicate confidently with senior decision-makers.
 As your experience develops, you will gain increasing exposure to customer meetings, discovery and the wider sales process.
 What We Are Looking For 
 We are not looking for someone who already knows everything about technology or enterprise sales. We are looking for people with the attitude, ambition and potential to become successful salespeople.
 You should have:
 A genuine desire to build a successful career in B2B sales.
 Ambition and motivation to progress.
 Confidence speaking with new people and starting conversations.
 A proactive and resilient mindset.
 Commercial curiosity and an interest in understanding how businesses operate.
 The ability to take feedback, respond to coaching and continuously improve.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Strong organisation and time-management skills.
 The confidence to engage professionally with senior stakeholders.
 A competitive but team-first attitude.
 The drive to take ownership of your own performance and development.
 You could be a graduate starting your career, already working in an entry-level sales role, or coming from a customer-facing environment where you have developed strong communication and relationship-building skills.
 Previous sales experience is beneficial, but not essential.
 Experience with B2B sales, cold calling, outbound prospecting, CRM platforms or working towards targets would be advantageous, but ultimately we are hiring for potential, attitude and ambition.
 Career Progression 
 The SDR role is designed as the starting point of your sales career at Techary:
 Sales Development Representative → Associate Account Manager → Account Manager
 You will initially focus on prospecting, opening conversations and qualifying opportunities before gaining greater exposure to discovery, customer meetings and opportunity management.
 As your skills and performance develop, you will have the opportunity to progress into an Associate Account Manager role and ultimately become an Account Manager, with responsibility for your own customers, pipeline and revenue.
 Progression is not simply based on time served. It is based on performance, development and demonstrating that you are ready to take on the next level of responsibility.

 Techary is a global technology business giving you the opportunity to work across a wide variety of customers, technologies and projects.

471e3449d4d7.description:
ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.


Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.




If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

This is a junior Personal Injury and Credit Hire Claims role, it designed for someone who is looking to start a career in complex claims. You'll support wider claims team and our customers through the claims journey. You'll gather evidence, generate reports, keep our systems up to date and always be there for our customer. 

What you will be doing

 - Learn on how to manage your own claims caseload in accordance with the Zego claims philosophy, claims handling procedures and service level agreements.

 - Chase. receive and log evidence and supporting documents from customers.

 - Responding proactively to incoming telephone calls and correspondence to avoid leakage and delays

 - Monitoring ongoing credit hire periods to drive down claim costs and raising payments promptly and accurately.

 - Liaising and negotiating with third party insurers and solicitors as well as credit hire organisations to progress and settle claims efficiently, with a pragmatic approach to claims handling.

 - Support with the work on Personal Injury claims inside and outside of MOJ/OIC portals.

 - Learn how to enter reserves accurately and promptly into the claims system in accordance with Zego reserving philosophy.

 - Learn how to conduct liability and quantum investigations, whilst considering whether there is potential for fraud.



What you will need to be successful

 - Claims handling experience in a insurance company or experience as a paralegal/legal assistant within a practice that deals with motor claims

 - Some working knowledge of the MOJ and OIC portals

 - Strong telephone negotiation skills.

 - Ability to plan, organise and prioritise own workload.

 - Ability to learn, adapt to change and embrace AI tools.




THE ZEGO WAYS OF WORKING 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QKOYDx6AMxQ.




BENEFITS 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.



Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Zego’s Complex Claims team is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a highly skilled Large Loss Claims Handler to join our team. Our large loss specialists handle Zego’s most complex and high value motor claims including those involving brain and spinal trauma, psychiatric injury, complex fractures and pain conditions.

In this pivotal role, reporting to the Motor Major Loss Manager, you’ll manage your own portfolio of motor cases, focusing on injury claims exceeding £500k. This position requires not only excellent communication and negotiation skills but also a deep understanding of liability, indemnity, and quantum issues to effectively drive down claims costs while ensuring fair compensation for injured claimants.

Alongside handling technical claims, this role involves introducing and executing a quality review programme within the complex loss team, as well as providing mentorship, oversight, and professional development through a structured training scheme.

Beyond handling claims, the team works closely with other claims colleagues, reinsurers, panel solicitors, carriers, rehab providers and colleagues across underwriting and pricing to deliver fair, commercially sound outcomes. As a small, highly technical team, we offer broad exposure to grow your career 🚀




WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

 - Managing a portfolio of high value motor claims typically valued between £500k through to £5 million, pre and post litigation

 - Communicate effectively with customers, witnesses, insurers, repairers, solicitors, and medical agencies to expedite claim resolutions

 - Serve as a technical expert within the team, offering guidance and support in large loss scenarios

 - Work with the Motor Major Loss Manager and our Head of TP & Complex Claims on Claims strategy and processes

 - Motivate and develop more junior team members by sharing your knowledge and expertise

 - Maintain Reinsurer and carrier relationships through timely and accurate updates

 - Investigate, negotiate and settle claims

 - Calculation of accurate reserves and make decisions on Indemnity and Liability claims

 - Participate in strategic projects to keep the team at the forefront of industry trends and performance




WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

 - Proven experience in managing high value motor bodily injury claims with a current handling authority of at least £250k

 - Deep knowledge of liability, indemnity, causation, reserving, future losses, the Ogden Discount Rate and complex medical issues

 - Experience handling litigated claims and applying relevant procedures and frameworks including CPR and MIB technical disputes

 - A passion for a career in Large Loss and a desire to help shape a growing large loss function

363daf2fb55e.description:
Graduate Fire Engineer 2027 Start – London 
 London, UK 
 Company Overview 
 At Jensen Hughes, we’ve been helping make our world safe, secure and resilient since 1939. Today, our global network of experts works across fire protection engineering, security and risk-based fields, including
accessibility consulting, risk analysis, process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management and digital innovation.
 Our engineers and consultants work together to solve complex safety and security challenges, helping our clients protect what matters most. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we continue toadvance the science of safety and make a meaningful difference to the communities we serve.
 At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives, skills and talents they bring to our organisation.
 Our Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organisation, supporting career development and creating opportunities to share experiences, build connections and learn from one another.
 Job Overview 
 Ready to start a career where your engineering skills can make a real difference?
 We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Fire Engineer to join Jensen Hughes across the UK and Ireland and become part of our 2,000+ global employees working together to advance the science of safety every day.
 These roles are open across our UK & Ireland offices. Please apply only to your preferred location. If you are open to more than one location, we will discuss this with you during the recruitment process.
 Please note: to be considered for this role, you must have the right to work in the UK or Ireland. 
 Why join Jensen Hughes and grow your career? 
 Your career can go further than you think. 74% of our current Directors and Technical Directors in the UK & Ireland started their careers with us as graduates.
 Be part of a leading fire consultancy. We have offices across Belgium, Finland, Italy, Denmark and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.
 Learn from experienced engineers. As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic design team. Working alongside experienced Engineers, you will receive ongoing technical support to build your knowledge and experience across fire engineering projects.
 Build your career in a supportive environment. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team where we strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.
 Take responsibility early. You will be given early responsibility and the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to work towards chartered status through the Institute of Fire Engineers, providing help and support throughout the process.
 What will you be working on? 
 As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you’ll work on a variety of exciting projects, helping to develop innovative fire engineering solutions for new and existing buildings.
 Your work will include:
 Carrying out fire engineering analysis on a
range of new and existing building projects.
 Working across a diverse range of buildings,
including high-rise office buildings, large retail complexes and airport
developments, each presenting its own unique challenges.
 Analysing fire growth, means of escape,
structural fire resistance and smoke control using a variety of methods,
including computer modelling software such as Computational Fluid Dynamics.
 Preparing technical reports and liaising with
clients, including some of the largest building developers in the country.
 Requirements and Qualifications 
 To set you up for success in the role, you’ll need:
 Right to work in the UK or Ireland.
 A Master’s degree, achieved within the last two
years or expected, in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering,
Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Physics.
 Exceptional written and verbal communication
skills in English.
 Additional qualifications and experience
 The following would also help you succeed in the role: 
 A team player who can work effectively with
colleagues at all levels.
 Excellent communication and time management
skills.
 Enthusiasm to innovate.
 A second European language is an advantage but
not essential.
 We’ve successfully welcomed Graduate Fire Engineers from a variety of STEM Master’s backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering and Physics. Many of these individuals have gone on to build outstanding careers with us.
 If you’re committed to pursuing a career in Fire Engineering and have a transferable STEM Master’s degree, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us why you’re ready to start your career with Jensen Hughes.
 Graduate Development Programme 
 Starting your career is about more than your first role, it’s about building the foundations for your future.
 Our Graduate Development Programme gives you hands-on project experience, mentorship and support as you work towards professional accreditation. Over two years, you’ll gain experience across fire engineering and related disciplines, helping you build the knowledge and skills needed for a successful and impactful career.
 You’ll also have the opportunity to undertake Continuing Professional Development (CPD) as you progress through the programme, helping you continue to develop your technical knowledge and professional skills. We provide support and encouragement for Engineers working towards Chartered Engineer status , helping you work towards this important professional milestone as you build your career with Jensen Hughes.
 Sustainability in Fire Engineering 
 At Jensen Hughes, fire safety and sustainability go hand in hand.
 In the UK, we support the design of safe, energy-efficient and sustainable buildings that meet BREEAM standards and align with net-zero goals. As a graduate, you’ll play a role in delivering solutions that protect people while helping to create a more sustainable built environment.
 Our People Are Our Greatest Asset 
 At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation of our success. To attract and retain the best talent, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance, and professional growth.
 Our UK&I Benefits Include: 
 Private medical insurance
 33 days of holiday(including
bank holidays) with an additional day after 3 years
 Industry-leading contributory pension scheme

fe42b60619c7.description:
Graduate Facades Engineer 2027 Start – London 
 London - UK 
 Company Overview 
 At Jensen Hughes, we’ve been helping make our world safe, secure and resilient since 1939. Today, our global network of experts works across fire protection engineering, security and risk-based fields, including
accessibility consulting, risk analysis, process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management and digital innovation.
 Our engineers and consultants work together to solve complex safety and security challenges, helping our clients protect what matters most. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we continue toadvance the science of safety and make a meaningful difference to the communities we serve.
 At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives, skills and talents they bring to our organisation.
 Our Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organisation, supporting career development and creating opportunities to share experiences, build connections and learn from one another.
 Job Overview 
 Ready to start a career where your engineering skills can make a real difference?
 We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Facade Engineer to join Jensen Hughes across the UK and Ireland and become part of our 2,000+ global employees working together to advance the science of safety every day.
 Please apply only to your preferred location. If you are open to more than one location, we will discuss this with you during the recruitment process.
 Please note: to be considered for this role, you must have the right to work in the UK or Ireland. 
 Why join Jensen Hughes and grow your career? 
 Your career can go further than you think. 74% of our current Directors and Technical Directors in the UK & Ireland started their careers with us as graduates.
 Be part of a leading fire consultancy. We have offices across Belgium, Finland, Italy, Denmark and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.
 Learn from experienced engineers. As a Graduate Façade Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic team, working alongside experienced Engineers to develop your knowledge and experience across façade engineering and external wall fire consultancy. You will gain structured exposure to façade systems, external wall fire performance and building envelope design, while developing core engineering skills across structural, thermal and fire performance disciplines. With support from senior engineers, you will contribute to technical project delivery while developing the judgement, competence and professional behaviours needed to progress within either the façade design or external wall consultancy pathway.
 Build your career in a supportive environment. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team where we strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.
 Take responsibility early. You will be given early responsibility and the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to work towards chartered status, providing help and support throughout the process.
 What will you be working on? 
 As a Graduate Facade Engineer, you’ll work on a variety of exciting projects.
 Your work will include:
 Support the review of architectural drawings, specifications, and technical information relating to façade and external wall systems.
 Assist in the preparation of technical reports, including external wall fire assessment reports, façade engineering notes, and supporting appendices.
 Support external wall fire safety assessments, including PAS 9980–led appraisals and related desktop studies.
 Participate in site inspections and intrusive surveys to establish external wall and façade build-ups, materials, fixings, and fire stopping provisions.
 Assist with thermal engineering tasks, including thermal bridging reviews, U-value assessments, condensation risk inputs, and interpretation of modelling outputs under supervision.
 Assist with structural engineering tasks related to façade systems, including basic load paths, fixings concepts, and interpretation of structural calculations prepared by senior engineers.
 Support the coordination and review of test evidence, certifications, and product data relevant to façade and external wall performance.
 Assist senior engineers with coordination between internal disciplines and external stakeholders.
 Attend site visits, design meetings, and client meetings as required, under supervision.
 Maintain accurate records, site notes, and project documentation in accordance with internal procedures.
 Actively participate in training, mentoring, and professional development activities.
 Work in accordance with Jensen Hughes quality, safety, and governance procedures at all times.
 During the first 12–24 months, we expect successful candidates to grow into the role by developing the following skills and competencies:
 Develop a sound understanding of façade systems, materials, and construction methods.
 Build familiarity with external wall fire safety principles, relevant legislation, and guidance.
 Gain practical site experience through inspections and surveys.
 Develop core skills in technical report writing and structured engineering reasoning.
 Build foundational understanding of thermal and structural performance as applied to façade systems.
 Demonstrate increasing independence in technical tasks under supervision.
 Progress towards professional accreditation and longer-term chartership pathways.
 Requirements and Qualifications 
 To set you up for success in the role, you’ll need:
 Right to work in the UK or Ireland.
 A Master’s degree, achieved within the last two years or expected, in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Physics.
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
 The following would also help you succeed in the role: 
 A second European language is an advantage but not essential.
 Interest in façade engineering, external walls, and fire safety.
 Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and specifications.
 Interest in thermal and/or structural aspects of façade performance.
 Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
 Collaborative approach and willingness to work as part of a multidisciplinary team.
 We’ve successfully welcomed Graduate Facade Engineers from a variety of STEM Master’s backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering and Physics. Many of these individuals have gone on to build outstanding careers with us.
 If you’re committed to pursuing a career in Facade Engineering and have a transferable STEM Master’s degree, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us why you’re ready to start your career with Jensen Hughes.
 Graduate Development Programme 
 Starting your career is about more than your first role, it’s about building the foundations for your future.
 Our Graduate Development Programme gives you hands-on project experience, mentorship and support as you work towards professional accreditation. Over two years, you’ll gain experience across fire engineering and related disciplines, helping you build the knowledge and skills needed for a successful and impactful career.
 You’ll also have the opportunity to undertake Continuing Professional Development (CPD) as you progress through the programme, helping you continue to develop your technical knowledge and professional skills. We provide support and encouragement for Engineers working towards Chartered Engineer status , helping you work towards this important professional milestone as you build your career with Jensen Hughes.

829cb58a58a9.title: Carbon Analyst
829cb58a58a9.description:
WHAT IS SYLVERA ANYWAY? ‍👩‍👨🌳

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.



We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.



Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.



If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.



What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻‍‍

Having found an early product-market fit in a nascent, rapidly growing space, we’re scaling our Ratings Team at pace to support our carbon data platform. We’re looking for a mission-driven analyst to conduct carbon project assessments and help build our expert assessment frameworks ensuring that everything we do is built on robust and comprehensive data and analysis. It’s a critical role at the heart of our business - you’ll work within a large team of multidisciplinary analysts, working together to leverage all the skills and insights necessary to drive value for our customers. You will report to our Nature-Based Solutions Lead. 



Specific responsibilities will include:

 - Conducting carbon project assessments, providing deep due diligence on carbon projects focussed on providing value to the customer through timely and robust data and insights

 - Conduct quantitative and qualitative research, such as assessing project documentation, scientific literature, news reports, modelling formulas, time series data, and geospatial data

 - Contributing toward process improvement initiatives and the design of systems and tooling to improve the speed and quality of our assessments

 - Collaborate with stakeholders across the business, notably in technology, data, product, commercial  teams

 - Ensuring that critical quality assurance processes are upheld to maintain our status as the markets most trusted data provider with our carbon project assessments

 - Promote and uphold best practices in the team, including keeping customer value at the heart of what we do

We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚

 - Based in London (this role is on-site, with five days a week in our London office)

 - Has up to 2 years professional experience in carbon markets or a similar field

 - Has deep critical thinking skills and the ability to apply logical principles in order to quickly determine actionable solution pathways to complex problems

 - Has experience delivering data insights as well as innovating new analytics

35c818055a76.description:
Overview 
 BoF is looking for an Editorial Operations Associate to join our Content Operations team. This is not an entry-level role. The successful candidate will have proven experience in a newsroom, publishing house or similar media environment, who can take real ownership of editorial production, AI-assisted workflows and support the key editorial products like BoF 500.
 You'll be trusted to run processes independently, make judgment calls under deadline pressure and work closely with editors and reporters, as well as the Design, Social Media and Multimedia Teams. 
 BoF is also becoming an AI-native company, and this role sits close to that shift: you'll use our approved AI tools daily, help shape how the newsroom adopts them, and hold the line on human verification and editorial standards as automation expands.
 Who Are We?
 The Business of Fashion is recognised around the world for its authoritative, analytical point of view on the global fashion and beauty industries. Our mission: to open, inform and connect the global fashion and beauty industries.
 Serving members in more than 125 countries, The Business of Fashion combines independent, agenda-setting journalism with practical business advice, online learning, career-building tools and immersive events, powering positive change in fashion and the wider world.
 Over time, our pioneering approach has made BoF the fashion industry’s leading source of business intelligence, and one of its most respected and influential voices, simply because you won’t find BoF’s original reporting, analysis and advice anywhere else. The Business of Beauty brings the same kind of agenda-setting coverage to the beauty and wellness space. Today, our talented team of correspondents, editors, analysts, engineers, designers, marketers and more numbers more than 100 people in London, New York, Paris and Milan.
 Commitment to Diversity 
 BoF is committed to building a diverse workforce and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunities employer. All applicants and employees receive equal treatment regardless of race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation, gender, age, disability, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity.
 Commitment to Inclusivity 
 BoF is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and reach their full potential within their roles using a growth mindset. We are committed to creating an inclusive culture for our employees globally.
 Commitment to Accessibility 
 BoF is committed to providing an accessible environment for all applicants throughout any stage of the recruitment process, by removing any barriers to ensure we offer a process that gives all of our applicants an opportunity to shine.
 We are committed to supporting candidates with visible or non-visible disabilities, including neurodiversity (eg: autism, ADHD, dyslexia) or mental health conditions. We will work with you to understand what adjustments you may need in the recruitment process to ensure you are able to perform at your best and we want to create a safe space to support this. Should you require any particular adjustment to be made, please let the Talent Acquisition Specialist who is managing your application know when you are contacted for an interview, so we can consider how best we can support you with this. 
 What We Need You To Do 
 Editorial operations 
 The smooth running of editorial operations, in close collaboration with the Editorial Operations team
 Production of BoF's newsletters and briefings
 Timely and accurate production and formatting of articles in our in-house CMS
 Image research and coordination with reporters and editors on the visual needs of articles
 Proofreading stories to ensure they are free of errors
 Monitoring news wires and other sources throughout the daily news cycle for stories to cover on site
 Supporting journalists with research and fact-checking across the newsroom
 AI use and development 
 Using BoF's approved AI tools day to day for production, research, transcription, formatting and quality checks
 Helping test, refine and document AI-assisted workflows for the newsroom, and identifying where automation genuinely improves speed or accuracy
 Building and maintaining prompts, templates and briefing notes so colleagues can adopt these workflows consistently
 Training and supporting editorial colleagues on new tools, and feeding back to Product & Tech on what works
 Applying rigorous human verification to any AI-assisted output, with clear personal accountability for accuracy and house style
 BoF 500 profile update ownership 
 Owning the BoF 500 profile update programme end to end
 Researching, drafting and updating profiles and index entries, ensuring every detail is verified, current and consistent with house style 
 Charts and data presentation 
 Supporting writers and editors to build charts, advising on which formats work best for the data and ensuring every figure is sourced and accurate
 Maintaining consistency of data presentation across charts, tables and exhibits, in line with house style
 Case studies 
 Working closely with the Case Study production team on production, formatting and publication of case studies
 Coordinating exhibits, imagery and supporting data so each case study is complete at publication
 Podcast and multimedia 
 Supporting production of BoF's podcast articles
 Special projects 
 Working on  editorial special projects, such as fashion week, BoF 500 and content-driven events 
 Who you are 
 You have a depth and breadth of experience working in a newsroom, publishing house, media company or similar fast-paced editorial environment, and you're ready to take full responsibility for processes. You're comfortable being the person others rely on to keep production moving and you bring judgment, not just diligence, to your work.
 You'll also have:
 Proven experience working on editorial production processes with minimal supervision
 Exceptional proofreading skills, with a sharp eye for house style and consistency
 Hands-on experience using AI tools in a professional workflow — for research, drafting, transcription, formatting or quality checks — and the judgment to know where AI helps and where it doesn't
 Strong organisational skills and the ability to run multiple work-streams at once without dropping detail
 A nose for relevant news stories across fashion and beauty, and the confidence to make editorial judgment calls under deadline
 Clear, concise and accurate writing
 Experience coordinating across teams — editors, reporters, design, social media, etc. — to get a piece of content from brief to publication
 A sense of curiosity and intellectual scepticism, including about AI-generated output
 Openness toward and honesty regarding feedback
 A creative flair for image selection, presentation and chart ideas; working knowledge of Photoshop would be an asset
 Comfort working with global, cross-timezone teams (New York, Los Angeles, Paris, Milan, London)
 A willingness to work a flexible schedule to meet the needs of a 24-hour news cycle
 You’ll Know You’re Successful When 
 Editorial operations run smoothly with minimal need for oversight, and you're proactively flagging risks before they become problems
 Features and news articles are published according to house style and free of errors
 Articles are supported by strong, engaging and on-brand visuals
 The BoF 500 update programme runs to plan, with accurate, verified, on-brand profiles delivered to deadline
 AI-assisted workflows you've built or refined are adopted by colleagues and measurably speed up or improve production, without compromising accuracy
 Case studies, charts and multimedia assets are complete, accurate and consistent at publication
 You end your working day with clear, meticulous handovers to the New York-based Editorial team, covering news, social, production and newsletters
 You work s

9ac51d09524c.description:
Company Overview   
 ClearView Healthcare Partners is a premier life sciences strategy consulting firm headquartered in Boston, with offices in San Francisco, New York City, London, Zurich and Gurgaon. Serving clients in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic spaces, we provide world-class strategic decision-making support across a diverse range of business issues. Our goal is to inform actionable recommendations that allow companies to achieve their business objectives. 
 At ClearView, you will encounter an entrepreneurial environment, interact with a dynamic group of colleagues, present to clients in critical business situations, and develop a deep understanding of the life sciences and biopharmaceutical industry. You will be mentored directly by ClearView managers, who have a wealth of experience in life sciences consulting .  As a Summer Intern, you will play a key role on project teams that span a wide range of strategic focus areas across the organization. This includes meaningful exposure to our core Pillars which may encompass New Product Planning, Pricing & Market Access, Investor Relations, Launch & Commercialization, Diagnostics/Medtech and Corporate Strategy. This cross-functional experience is designed to accelerate your professional development while contributing to high-impact initiatives that shape the future of our business.   
 You will also have time to socialize with your peers and ClearView employees throughout the summer with various activities within and outside of the office. 
 Responsibilities   
 You will work on internal ClearView teams and directly with clients to address critical strategic questions within the biopharmaceutical space. You will be afforded opportunities to refine a broad range of expertise, skills, and connections that will heighten your career.  During a typical project, you will engage in several activities, including:   
 Assess complex problems through a hypothesis-based approach.   
 Primary and secondary research to drive to critical insights.   
 Create and utilize analytic tools (e.g., forecast models) to support key decision-making.   
 Communicate recommendations to clients to inform strategy and maximize value.   
 Requirements   
 We are seeking motivated individuals pursuing a life sciences degree and demonstrated interested in consulting and/or the biopharmaceutical industry. A successful Summer Analyst candidate will meet the following requirements:   
 Pursuing an Undergraduate or Master’s degree majoring or minoring in Life Sciences with a graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028. If you are graduating in September 2028, you must have your degree finished before early- to mid-September 
 Demonstrated interest in consulting and the life sciences industry through a combination of research and club participation is preferred    
 Desire to work for a mission driven organization    
 Strong written and oral communication skills   
 Experience using Microsoft Office Suite (e.g. Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)   
 Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate research synthesis and deliver insights faster than traditional methods   
 Enthusiasm for working in a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative team-based environment   
 Demonstrated leadership abilities   
 Highly analytical and structured approach to solving complex problems   
 The internship is a 9-week summer program, taking place from 12 July to 10 September 2027. 
 DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS ARE 30 OCTOBER 2026 AT 11:59PM GMT. INTERVIEWS WILL BEGIN IN LATE NOVEMBER, IF SELECTED, AND CANDIDATES WILL BE INVITED ON A ROLLING BASIS.   
 What We Value 
 We recognize that not every candidate will meet every qualification listed. If you’re excited about this role and believe you have relevant experience or transferable skills, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, a growth mindset, and a commitment to collaboration.
 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 ClearView Healthcare Partners ("CV") is an Equal Opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

e30ebc09c0b9.description:
About Us 
 At BGBx , we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.   
 Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.   
 If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a  meaningful impact at BGBx.    
 Position Overview: 
 This vacancy is specifically for students who are set to graduate between December 2027 and June 2028. 
 Kx Advisors, BGBx Consulting team, is seeking to expand its ranks with an ambitious and motivated Summer Associate Consultant. Kx Advisors provides strategic support to executives at leading Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, and Health IT companies. Our work leverages primary research, data analysis, and knowledge/learnings from previous engagements to support critical commercial decisions for Global 500 corporations in the healthcare sector through portfolio strategy, market and opportunity assessment, commercial due diligence, go to market strategies, competitive strategy, and product commercialization. 
 Summer Associate Consultants are active participants in strategic consulting engagements at Kx Advisors. As a critical part of our small project teams, you’ll have ownership of the same responsibilities as our full-time Associate Consultants, have daily opportunities to interact with firm leaders, and contribute to the generation of tangible results for our clients.
 Are you passionate about solving problems? Energized by the idea of working with the world’s most admired corporations? Craving an opportunity to explore your interest in consulting in a meaningful way this summer?
 If you’re ready to explore your interest in consulting in a hands-on way, challenge yourself intellectually, and be a meaningful contributor to engagements that impact organizations throughout the world, apply today to be a Summer Associate Consultant at Kx Advisors. 
 This position is hybrid based out of our London office. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Conduct extensive primary and secondary research, including interviewing industry participants and stakeholders and performing comprehensive literature research
 Analyze and synthesize research results with your engagement team to develop actionable conclusions and insights for your client
 Support the development of engaging deliverables to share strategic key findings with clients
 Participate in client calls and presentations, as well as assisting with client communications
 Be supported by an exceptional group of peers and leaders as you take on significant challenges and develop the highest quality recommendations and solutions for our clients
 Qualifications:  
 High achievement in business and/or analytically focused coursework from a distinguished three or four-year college or university
 Demonstrated success in basic primary and secondary research techniques, including the ability to creatively leverage a variety of sources to uncover unique data and insights
 Demonstrated ability to “connect the dots” by analyzing data to draw accurate, concise, and effective conclusions
 A record of achievements that demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit, a high level of self-motivation, proactive tendencies, and a “can-do” attitude in challenging situations
 Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, project management, and time management competencies
 Salary range: 21.25 GBP/hour 
 What We Offer 
 At BGBx, we invest in our people because exceptional talent drives exceptional work. We provide a competitive rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, professional growth, and life outside of work.
 Our benefits package typically includes health care insurance, retirement plans, generous paid time off and holidays, wellness benefits, life insurance, learning and development opportunities, and other resources that support our employees throughout their careers.  Additional benefits may be available based on your location.  Beyond benefits, you'll find a culture built on collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on healthcare and the people it serves.
 BGBx is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status or any category or class of person protected by law.

c1767a4b2e33.title: 2027 Graduate Programme - Macro Risk
c1767a4b2e33.description:
Application deadline:   1 December 2026
 Programme start date:    September 2027
 Eligibility:   Final year students graduating in 2027
 Who we are: 
 Rothesay is the UK’s largest pensions insurance specialist, purpose-built to protect pension schemes and their members’ pensions. With over £74 billion of assets under management, we secure the pensions of more than one million people and pay out, on average, approximately £350 million in pension payments each month.
 Rothesay is dedicated to providing excellence in customer service alongside prudent underwriting, a conservative investment strategy and the careful management of risk. We are trusted by the pension schemes of some of the UK’s best known companies to provide pension solutions, including British Airways, Cadbury, the Civil Aviation Authority, the Co-Operative, Morrisons, Smiths Industries and Telent. At Rothesay, we are striving to transform our industry. We believe deeply in creating real security for the future and our leadership in finding new and better ways to do that is the key to our success. To do that, we need the very brightest original thinkers to bring creativity as well as rigour. Rothesay is a rewarding place to work, where quality people can thrive and prosper. We pride ourselves on the connections our people build, many of whom have been with us for over ten years.
 Graduate Programme: 
 Our UK graduate programme is designed to kick-start careers for ambitious and analytical graduates who want to make an impact. Rothesay is built on a multi-talented, multi-disciplined model, collaborating directly and with singular focus to shape the future. Rothesay’s inclusive and collaborative working environment allows our graduates to build a broad skill-set and shape a strong internal network. We support your development journey, growth in your career, in addition to offering a competitive salary and tailored benefits.
 Our 2 year* programme starts with a fundamentals week for the entire graduate cohort, where you will have in depth networking and insight sessions on Rothesay as a whole. From week two, you will join your team for professional integrated learning and start to make meaningful contributions. Throughout your first year, alongside your permanent role, you will be part of an on-site graduate development programme with both technical and business skills training.  Our teams run lean, giving you excellent visibility and exposure throughout the business, and we will provide continuous training and upskilling for your future.  Rothesay is a rewarding place to work, where quality people can thrive and prosper.  Regular reviews will take place to support your learning and development with a formal assessment towards the end of the programme.
 This opportunity is open to summer 2027 graduates who are looking to launch into their career within an entrepreneurial environment where talent can thrive and excel.
 What you’ll do: 
 As a Risk Graduate within the Macro Risk function, you will be part of the team responsible for Market, Liquidity and Counterparty Credit Risk Management.  In conjunction with other members of the team you will identify, monitor and help mitigate these risks on Rothesay’s balance sheet though stress testing, limit setting and monitoring, capital model development and maintenance as well as deep dives and ad-hoc projects. This role will require you to collaborate extensively and build relationships across the firm in particular with Trading Desks, Strats and the Treasury function.
 When you join us you will start as a generalist developing a broad understanding of the risk management discipline as it applies to Rothesay’s business model.  Subsequently you are expected to choose one or more areas of specialisation and become a subject matter expert.
 Professional development such as attainment of CFA and FRM designations will be encouraged. 
 The Macro Risk graduate path has been a proven launchpad for successful careers in both Risk and Front Office.
 What we offer 
 A meritocratic, driven and stimulating environment where success and achievement are rewarded
 Work with support from leaders in the industry and excellent on-the-job training supplemented with class-based business training where best applied
 A competitive starting salary with a performance related bonus
 What we are looking for 
 We recruit from all academic disciplines, although a high degree of numeracy and logical approach to problem-solving are required.
 Excellent academic credentials are essential. You must have a minimum of a 2:1 or equivalent degree from a leading university.
 Internships & work experience in the financial services is highly desired but not essential.
 You will need to demonstrate a clear interest and intellectual curiosity in the financial markets.
 Coding proficiency a distinct plus.
 Fluency in English is a pre-requisite.
 Rothesay competencies: 
 Technical Skills - Demonstrates strong technical skills required for the role, pays attention to detail, takes initiative to broaden his/her knowledge and demonstrates appropriate analytical skills
 Drive and Motivation – Be a self-starter; successfully handles multiple tasks, takes initiative to improve his/her own performance, works intensely towards extremely challenging goals and persists in the face of obstacles or setbacks
 Teamwork – Demonstrate evidence of being a strong team player, collaborates with others within and across teams, encourages other team members to participate and contribute and acknowledges others' contributions
 Communication Skills - Communicates what is relevant and important in a clear and concise manner and shares information/new ideas with others
 Judgement and Problem solving - Thinks ahead, anticipates questions, plans for contingencies, finds alternative solutions and identifies clear objectives. Sees the big picture and effectively analyses complex issues
 Creativity/Innovation - Looks for new ways to improve current processes and develop creative solutions that are grounded in reality and have practical value
 Influencing Outcomes - Presents sound, persuasive rationale for ideas or opinions. Takes a position on issues and influences others' opinions and presents persuasive recommendations
 Disclaimer : This position description is intended to describe the duties most frequently performed by an individual in this position. It is not intended to be a complete list of assigned duties, but to describe a position level.  The role shall be performed within a professional office environment. Rothesay has health and safety polices that are available for all workers upon request.  There are no specific health risks associated with the role. 
 Inclusion: Rothesay actively promotes diversity and inclusivity. We know that our success depends on our people and that by nurturing a culture that values difference, we create a stronger, more dynamic business. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability or age. 
 The collection of applicant diversity data allows Rothesay to map and gain insights into the impact of our DEI strategy for talent attraction. This data is anonymised and is not analysed against individual applications. By requesting mapping our applicants’ demographic profiles, we can identify the under-represented groups. This enables us to identify any barriers to increasing our diversity and take action.
