994c52d5ad22.title: Summer 2027 - Investment Internship LDN
994c52d5ad22.description:
We see the world differently at Capstone Investment Advisors. You will, too.   
 Capstone is a global, alternative investment management firm operating across a broad range of derivatives-based strategies with a deep understanding of volatility. With approximately $14.6 billion of AUM and 315 employees (as of September 1, 2026, Capstone was formed in 2007 and is headquartered in New York with offices in London, Amsterdam, Tokyo, California, Stamford, Boston, and Milan.    
 At Capstone, we constantly aim to expand our view of how WE SEE THE WORLD DIFFERENTLY® in order to create opportunity. Our commitment to provoking the evolution of asset management provides us with a perpetual hunger for knowledge that we believe drives the improvement of our particular approach to investment. We seek to harness the complexities of global derivatives markets with disciplined strategic insight, an experienced, accomplished team and advanced technology to create sustainable value. We’ve created a particular approach to investment that we believe drives continuous improvement and opportunities for our clients, team and industry.   
 Overview:   
 Capstone’s 2027 Summer Internship is a ten-week program designed to provide practical exposure to the firm’s investment activities and working environment. Interns are expected to support an investment pod and complete a defined project intended to provide a meaningful learning experience while addressing a relevant business need.   
 We are seeking intellectually curious, analytical, and motivated candidates with a demonstrated interest in financial markets and investment management. Interns may gain exposure to investment research, market analysis, quantitative methods, automation and the day-to-day activities of their assigned team. Potential pod placements may include Sovereign Rates Relative Value, Global Equity Volatility, Quantitative Strategies, Convertible Bond Arbitrage, and Equity Capital Markets, among others. Placement, responsibilities, project scope, and exposure will be determined based on business needs, team capacity, and candidate experience and may vary by location and over the course of the program.   
 Our future colleague has these skills:   
 Current enrollment in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in a quantitative discipline, such as Economics, Econometrics, Finance, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.   
 Proficiency in Python and/or Java, including the ability to apply programming skills to data analysis, quantitative problem-solving, or similar technical work.   
 Strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to contribute effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.   
 Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical colleagues.   
 A professional, accountable approach to work and an ability to collaborate in a manner consistent with the firm’s culture and values.   
 Do you possess these Bonus Skills:   
 Prior internship, academic, or professional experience within financial services, investment management, or a related field is preferred.   
 Intellectual curiosity, the openness to share ideas, humility, the highest ethical standards and a desire to excel are a few of the traits that it takes to thrive and be your best self at Capstone.   
 To thrive at Capstone, a keen curiosity about technology and artificial intelligence is essential, as we continually drive innovation and enhance our strategic capabilities.    
 Benefits and Compensation Information:    
 Our team is our most important asset and investment. We value and respect our colleagues and their well-being inside and outside the workplace and our culture reflects this.    
 The hourly pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

501b70f93c06.location: Bruxelles, Belgium London, United Kingdom - Deliveroo
501b70f93c06.description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 Marketing Intern
 Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand. We’re looking for a Marketing Intern to join our team. In this role, you’ll gain hands-on experience supporting a variety of projects, from social media coordination to community engagement, helping us grow our brand presence.
 What You’ll Be Doing
 You’ll be joining the Brand & Experience team. We are a creative and fast-paced group dedicated to making Deliveroo the world’s most loved delivery brand. You will play a key role in assisting with day-to-day tasks and contributing to the success of our local marketing efforts.
 Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:
 Support Campaigns: Assist in the planning and organisation of key marketing campaigns, collaborating across the team to ensure smooth execution.

 Manage Ambassadors: Help manage partnerships with brand ambassadors, including coordination, performance tracking, and planning.
 Drive Community Engagement: Interact with our audience by responding to messages and comments, actively seeking ways to increase brand visibility.
 Create Content: Support the team with the creation and distribution of engaging content across multiple digital channels.
 What You’ll Need to Thrive
 Essential Educational Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

 Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a keen eye for detail.
 Digital Savvy: A strong understanding of social media platforms and current digital trends.
 Proactive Mindset: An enthusiastic, "can-do" attitude with a genuine eagerness to learn and take on new challenges.
 Nice to Have

 Previous experience in a customer-facing or community-focused role.
 Why Join Us?
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.
 Working here you can expect to:
 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
 If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

5ec1cf43fe9b.title: Executive Assistant
5ec1cf43fe9b.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the EA role at Trainline 👋

We’re looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to be a true right-hand partner to our Chief Product Officer and 3 cross functional VPs - bringing calm, clarity and momentum to a demanding, globally connected schedule. You’ll manage agendas end-to-end (prep, logistics, comms, attendees), act as a gatekeeper for leadership time, and help run key meeting cadences including planning, QBRs, reviews and offsites. The role is hybrid and requires regular in-office presence to support leaders and collaborate seamlessly with other EAs and cross-functional stakeholders.



As an EA at Trainline, you will... 🚄

 - Agenda management; keep ahead of potential scheduling conflicts; using initiative to find solutions and communicate changes in a timely manner

 - Act as a gatekeeper for leaders’ time, balancing strategic priorities with operational realities

 - Inbox management and correspondence

 - Support leadership rhythms such as planning cycles, QBRs, reviews and offsites

 - Travel management including flights, trains, taxis, arranging visas and accommodation

 - Creation and execution of cost-effective, detailed travel itineraries

 - Event planning both in-house and offsite

 - Project support as required

 - Support for new staff

 - Expense management and reporting

 - Work cross-functionally with a wide variety of teams

 - Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and sound judgment 
   Build strong relationships with other EAs and stakeholders to coordinate seamlessly at pace



We would love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

 - Experience supporting at Director/C-Suite level

 - A self-starter who has experience working autonomously within a fast-paced Technology focused company with an ever-changing and pressurised environment

 - Understand the need to prioritise and plan; however, be agile and comfortable enough to react to ever changing landscapes, business demands, and can make the step change seamlessly in a tech driven organisation

 - Accustomed to the demands of multiple Executives requiring conflicting changes simultaneously.

 - Able to work under pressure to strict deadlines and manage workload effectively under very demanding conditions.

 - Ability to organise and prioritise with strong attention to detail

 - Able to build strong relationships across the business with both internal and external stakeholders

 - Strong prioritisation skills and sound judgement

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

b0f5ce711428.title: Product Designer, Internship
b0f5ce711428.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
The Palantir Design Team is responsible for the human experience of using our software. Our team is growing rapidly, but we're committed to creating a tight-knit team environment that fosters trust, integrity, empathy, and growth. We work together in realizing a shared product vision, and regularly give feedback and critique to each other.

Designing at Palantir is a varied experience. On a given day, you might be: leading a design sprint for your product team; designing a micro-interaction to make a complex analytical task feel simple; and/or advocating for UX consistency by creating flexible, reusable UI components.
 Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).
 As a Product Design intern, your responsibilities look similar to a full-time designer, with the resources, stability, and mentorship of an established tech company. You’ll work on product teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of real product features. You will work with fellow Designers, Product Managers, Developers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to refine and evolve the quality of Palantir products.
 Interaction and visual design . You'll be involved at every stage of design work. You'll help define early product concepts, flesh out the high-level workflow and micro-interactions of a feature, and execute on a crisp and effective visual design. You should have experience designing and prototyping using tools such as Figma.
 User research . We frequently do informal user research, and value people who can be flexible with research processes and methodologies to achieve the right outcome. You'll often visit customer offices to interview and learn from the users we serve. You'll pair qualitative methods (e.g. scripted usability tests and contextual inquiry) with quantitative information, like product and usage metrics.
 Deliver and communicate designs in close collaboration . We work closely with product and forward deployed engineers to realize our design ideas. You'll treat engineers and product managers as partners and collaborate with them to prototype and build out products.
 Awareness of how software interfaces are built. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Typescript is appreciated. You don't need to be an expert—just fluent enough to collaborate with engineers, and know what's possible with frontend technologies. Core Responsibilities Excellent collaboration and communication skills with the ability to build great relationships with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders, and convey and debate design rationale.
 High empathy and dedication to the user, striving to understand and empower them.
 An iterative design process. You validate your ideas early (with stakeholders and users) and are thoughtful and intentional in seeking and responding to feedback. You move fast, listen, and adapt. You rapidly incorporate feedback, and prioritize collaboration. You are adept at giving and receiving critiques.
 Excitement for solving hard, complex problems. You are excited to design for technically complex and data dense interfaces. You thrive in an environment where you can jump into deep subject matter expertise to define simple, approachable, yet still powerful product experiences.
 Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, and the ability to ask questions when needed. What We Value Must be planning on graduating in 2028. This should be your final internship before graduating.
 A portfolio demonstrating at least one software interface design project. If parts of your portfolio are password-protected, please include your portfolio password under 'Additional Questions' when applying. What We Require

577f5b4d14e5.title: Assistant Management Accountant
577f5b4d14e5.description:
What we’re all about.

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organizations make better, more trusted decisions. As we continue our rapid global expansion, we are looking for an ambitious and detail-oriented Assistant Management Accountant to join our dynamic Group Reporting team.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The opportunity.

This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within a fast-paced, high-growth global technology environment. Sitting in our Group Reporting team, you will play a key role in supporting the month-end close, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring compliance across multiple international entities.

This role offers valuable exposure to global operations, complex cost structures, and cutting-edge financial systems. Beyond standard transactional accounting, you will have direct opportunities to lead financial analysis, generate commercial insights, and collaborate cross-functionally with teams across our business.

What you’ll be doing.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

 - Perform monthly P&L analysis, investigating and documenting key movements, trends, and variances.

 - Prepare and present insightful month-end commentary to the Finance Manager and wider team.

 - Maintain balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring any differences are fully explained and resolved.

 - Support the Finance Manager with ad-hoc analysis, reporting, and strategic project work.

Month-End Close & Cost Management

 - Prepare expense accrual and prepayment journals at month-end.

 - Contribute to the maintenance of the Group’s fixed asset registers.

 - Support the Accounts Payable team with timely invoice processing and accurate cost coding.

 - Review pending/disputed bills and new purchase requests to determine and post adequate accruals.

 - Collaborate on wider month-end close tasks across various Group entities.

Audit & Tax Compliance

 - Assist with Group audit information requests and statutory requirements.

 - Prepare VAT workings and returns in line with local tax regulations.

 - Assist with the preparation of annual corporate tax returns for regulatory filings.

 - Ensure strict compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, and high-quality documentation standards.

Technology & Process Improvement

 - Identify opportunities to streamline accounting workflows and enhance reporting efficiency.

 - Support the adoption and integration of new finance tools and ERP systems into daily workflows.

What you’ll bring.

 - Experience: A solid background in finance, ideally gained in a similar management accounting or assistant accountant role.

 - Qualification: Part-qualified accountant (ACCA/CIMA) or equivalent progress.

 - Technical Accounting: A robust understanding of accruals, prepayments, and the rhythm of a month-end close.

 - International Exposure: Prior experience with multi-entity accounting and international operations is highly desirable.

 - Systems & Excel: Strong Microsoft Excel skills are a must; familiarity with ERP systems (such as NetSuite) and automation tools is a plus.

 - Mindset: An analytical thinker who is comfortable turning raw data into actionable business insights.

 - Communication: Excellent communication skills with the confidence to partner with global teams.

 - Adaptability: A proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment.



Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

 - Competitive salary & Company bonus

 - 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

 - Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

 - Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

 - Life Insurance and Income Protection

 - Regularly bench-marked salary rates

 - Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

 - Well-being days

 - Volunteer Day off

 - Work from Home Equipment

 - Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

 - Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

 - Continuous Training and Development

 - Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

 - Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

4fd5d2eb609f.title: Research Scientist - Interactive Avatars
4fd5d2eb609f.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Scientist, you will join a team of 40+ researchers and engineers in our R&D department, working on the frontier of generative AI with a focus on avatar-centric, interactive video diffusion models.

This is a unique opportunity for experts in machine learning and diffusion models to shape the future of AI video agents that listen, respond, and react like humans. As part of our Interactive Avatars team, you'll build models that hold natural, real-time conversations: understanding what a user says and how they say it, then responding with appropriate turn-taking, backchannels, gaze, and facial and body reactions. You'll join a team that moves fast, iterates often, and turns breakthrough research into product capabilities that ship.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Contribute to the research direction for dyadic interaction modeling, and own well-scoped research problems end to end.

 - Advance the state of the art in the perceptual layer of interactive agents, including understanding user audio and video and generating contextually appropriate reactions.

 - Post-train multimodal models to generate rich, natural dyadic interactions from user audio and video inputs.

 - Adapt diffusion models to new conditioning signals, such as conversational state, turn-taking, and listener cues.

 - Build robust evaluation frameworks and test suites for continuous tracking of interaction quality.

 - Partner with our data team to define data needs and shape high-quality datasets.

 - Run rigorous experiments, and share findings that inform the team's technical decisions.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A strong ML background and hands-on experience with diffusion models, ideally for video or avatar generation.

 - Publications at top-tier venues (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH) in areas such as world models, dyadic interaction, or video diffusion, or equivalent demonstrated impact.

 - Experience taking research ideas through to working implementations, and motivation to see them reach production.

 - Proficiency in PyTorch and modern ML tooling for large-scale training.

 - Clear communication of hypotheses, experiments, and results.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with real-time or streaming generation, including autoregressive video diffusion.

 - Distillation or other techniques for low-latency inference.

 - Audio-driven facial, gesture, or full-body motion modeling.

 - Conversational modeling, such as turn-taking, backchanneling, or listener-response generation.

 - Experience mentoring students or junior researchers.


WHY JOIN US?

 - Build production-scale video foundation models in a fast-growing Generative AI company

 - Work on human-centric video generation with real-world impact

 - Tackle hard problems in scaling, stability, and controllability

 - Influence the direction of next-generation synthetic human technology

 - Join a highly technical, high-ownership environment where your work ships

If you want to work on cutting-edge generative video models and see your research power real-world products, we’d love to talk.

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. https://www.notion.so/How-we-work-at-Synthesia-f794caa72f8446efb6be22b551ce0fa2?pvs=21

 


SERVING 50,000+ CUSTOMERS (AND 50% OF THE FORTUNE 500)

We’re trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald’s and more. Read stories from happy customers https://www.synthesia.io/case-studies and what 1,200+ people say on G2 https://www.g2.com/products/synthesia/reviews#reviews.

 


PROPRIETARY AI TECHNOLOGY

Since 2017, we’ve been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Our AI technology is built in-house, by a team of world-class AI researchers and engineers. Learn more about our AI Research Lab and the team behind. https://www.synthesia.io/research

 


AI SAFETY, ETHICS AND SECURITY

AI safety, ethics, and security are fundamental to our mission. While the full scope of Artificial Intelligence's impact on our society is still unfolding, our position is clear: People first. Always. Learn more about our commitments to AI Ethics, Safety & Security https://www.synthesia.io/ethics.

23421c76a029.title: 2027 Summer Internship Programme - Capital & Pricing Actuarial
23421c76a029.description:
Application deadline : 1 December 2026
 Programme start date: June 2027
 Eligibility:   Penultimate year students graduating in Summer 2028
 Who we are: 
 Rothesay is the UK’s largest pensions insurance specialist, purpose-built to protect pension schemes and their members’ pensions. With over £69 billion of assets under management, we secure the pensions of nearly one million people and pay out, on average, approximately £350 million in pension payments each month.
 Rothesay is dedicated to providing excellence in customer service alongside prudent underwriting, a conservative investment strategy and the careful management of risk. We are trusted by the pension schemes of some of the UK’s best known companies to provide pension solutions, including British Airways, Cadbury’s, the Civil Aviation Authority, the Co-Operative Group, National Grid, NatWest, Morrisons and Telent.
 At Rothesay, we are striving to transform our industry. We believe deeply in creating real security for the future and our leadership in finding new and better ways to do that is the key to our success. To do that, we need the very brightest original thinkers to bring creativity as well as rigour. Rothesay is a rewarding place to work, where quality people can thrive and prosper. We pride ourselves on the connections our people build, many of whom have been with us for over ten years.
 Internship Programme: 
 Our internship programme is designed to provide hands on work experience within a fast-pace financial services environment, allowing you to develop the key skills to jump-start your career.  
 The 8 week structured programme will start with a fundamentals week offering insight into Rothesay, your team and the financial services industry.  Through-out the programme there will be both on-desk and off-desk technical and business skills training, providing career building exposure to accelerate your future after you graduate.  You will gain visibility and experience in a flat structure, with the opportunity to network and socialise across different levels and teams throughout the firm.  Rothesay is a rewarding place to work, where quality people can thrive and prosper.
 What you’ll do: 
 We have vacancies in the Pricing and Reinsurance team and the Capital team.
 The Pricing and Reinsurance team focuses on the pricing, underwriting, negotiation and execution of new pension and reinsurance deals, working on deals across all segments of the market. Whilst with the Pricing team, you will be expected to work on a real, live transaction, gaining genuine insight into the nature of the role.
 The Capital team monitors Rothesay’s regulatory and economic capital positions, and is responsible for the business' actuarial life insurance reporting. Its work includes computing the financial impact of prospective liability or asset transactions, alongside delivering strategic regulatory-driven projects, including the submission for the industry-wide market risk stress testing exercise.
 When you join us, your work will be highly varied involving all aspects of pensions and insurance actuarial work, and will involve significant interaction both internally with other teams and disciplines throughout the business, and externally, with clients and advisors.  You will need to be able to balance teamwork, intellectual curiosity and leadership potential with a passion for excellence and an interest in the financial markets.  Candidates joining these teams on a permanent basis would be expected to study for the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA) qualification with an expected specialism in pensions or life insurance. 
 What we offer: 
 A meritocratic, driven and stimulating environment where success and achievement are rewarded
 Work with support from leaders in the industry and excellent on-the-job training supplemented with class-based business training where best applies
 What we are looking for: 
 We primarily seek candidates from quantitative degrees, but will also consider applicants from other academic backgrounds with strong numerical ability.
 Impeccable academic credentials are essential. You must have an expected degree minimum of a 2:1 or equivalent from a leading university.
 Demonstrable interest in the insurance sector is essential
 Fluency in English is a prerequisite.
 Disclaimer:  This position description is intended to describe the duties most frequently performed by an individual in this position. It is not intended to be a complete list of assigned duties, but to describe a position level.  The role shall be performed within a professional office environment. Rothesay has health and safety polices that are available for all workers upon request.  There are no specific health risks associated with the role. 
 Inclusion: Rothesay actively promotes diversity and inclusivity. We know that our success depends on our people and that by nurturing a culture that values difference, we create a stronger, more dynamic business. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability or age. 
 The collection of applicant diversity data allows Rothesay to map and gain insights into the impact of our DEI strategy for talent attraction. This data is anonymised and is not analysed against individual applications. By requesting mapping our applicants’ demographic profiles, we can identify the under-represented groups. This enables us to identify any barriers to increasing our diversity and take action.

3ef986d6547b.title: Junior Executive Assistant
3ef986d6547b.description:
Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 
 How we started: 
 Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX   was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.
 Where we are now: 
 We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.
 In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.
 Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.
 Where we’re going: 
 2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.
 There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality! 
 The Opportunity
 As Junior Executive Assistant, you’ll work at the heart of HeliosX, supporting three to four members of our Executive Leadership Team across diaries, travel, events and day-to-day coordination. You’ll be the second person in our EA function and will be mentored by an EA who joined HeliosX without a traditional EA background, built the function from scratch and now supports five executives. You don’t need previous EA or PA experience. We’re hiring for attitude, judgement and potential - the practical side of the role can be taught. HeliosX moves quickly and priorities change often. From your first week, you’ll work directly with senior leaders, gain exposure to how the business operates and take on more responsibility as the EA function grows. This is a full-time, permanent role with a hybrid working arrangement based at our London HQ.
 What you’ll do
 Manage diaries for three to four members of the Executive Leadership Team, resolving conflicts and adapting quickly as priorities change.
 Protect leaders’ time, making sure meetings have the right purpose, people and information.
 Arrange domestic and international travel, including complex itineraries and last-minute changes.
 Coordinate meetings, offsites and company events, managing venues, suppliers, catering and logistics.
 Support with inbox management, meeting actions and follow-ups.
 Act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
 Manage confidential documents, expenses, purchase orders, contract renewals and other day-to-day administration.
 Build strong relationships across the business to help things move quickly and smoothly.
 What you’ll bring
 You don’t need to have been an EA before. We’re looking for evidence that people trust and rely on you - whether that comes from hospitality, retail, customer service, events, office support, healthcare, university, sport or another fast-paced environment.
 Experience organising something end to end, with multiple people, moving parts and a deadline.
 Strong organisation and follow through - you keep track of details and make sure things get done.
 Emotional intelligence - you read people well and adapt your approach.
 Proactivity and ownership - you spot what needs doing rather than waiting to be asked.
 Composure - when priorities change, you re-plan and keep moving.
 Good judgement and discretion, particularly when handling confidential or sensitive information.
 Clear, confident written and verbal communication.
 Confidence using Google Workspace, or evidence that you pick up new tools quickly.
 Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, or an interest in learning to use them well.
 At HeliosX, we want to improve healthcare for everyone, and to do this we need a team of brilliant people who share that ambition. We are currently a diverse team of engineers, scientists, clinical researchers, physicians, pharmacists, marketeers, and customer care specialists committed to our mission - but we need more talented folks to join us if we want to achieve our global ambitions!
Aside from working with our all-star team, here are some of the other benefits you may be eligible for coming on board: 
 Generous equity allocations with significant upside potential
 Annual leave allowance alongside public holidays
 Private health insurance, along with pre-existing condition, dental, and eye care cover
 Pension scheme
 Enhanced parental leave
 Cycle-to-work scheme
 Electric car scheme
 Free Dermatica and MedExpress products every month, as well as family discounts
 Annual home working and L&D allowance
 Free Headspace subscription, employee assistance programme, and discounted gym memberships

c65dd95862c6.title: Junior Commercial Associate — Works in Progress
c65dd95862c6.description:
Location: London, in office
Reports to: Head of Commercial and Audiovisual, Works in Progress
Salary: £30k-35k   
 About Works in Progress 
 Works in Progress is Stripe’s magazine of new and underrated ideas to improve the world. We publish an eclectic mix of articles on policy, economics, business, technology, science, history, arts and culture.
 Our audience is growing quickly and includes people making things happen, particularly in technology and politics. We are expanding the commercial side of the magazine—including advertising, subscriptions, events and partnerships—and are looking for an ambitious graduate to help us build it.
 The role 
 This is an entry-level commercial role for a recent graduate who is ambitious, organised and excited to learn quickly in a small, entrepreneurial team.
 You will work closely with the Director of Commercial and Audiovisual across the magazine’s commercial activity: advertising, subscriptions, events, marketing and partnerships. You will help keep commercial projects moving by conducting research, supporting outreach, maintaining pipelines and trackers, following up with prospective partners, and contributing to growth experiments.
 You will learn by doing: writing outbound emails, building target lists, preparing materials, tracking results, joining calls and following up consistently. It is a strong opportunity for someone who wants early exposure to senior commercial work and meaningful responsibility from the start of their career.
 What you’ll do 
 Support the advertising sales process, including preparing rate cards, pitch decks, outreach and pipeline materials.
 Research and build target lists of potential advertisers, sponsors, agencies, founders, investors and partners.
 Draft clear, thoughtful outbound emails and follow-ups.
 Maintain accurate CRM records, commercial trackers and reporting.
 Support subscription growth through acquisition and retention ideas, and help measure their effectiveness.
 Help develop the events business, including sponsor research, partnership outreach and event planning support.
 Assist with early marketing and growth experiments across paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, direct mail and audience development.
 Prepare decks, reports and briefing materials that help commercial conversations move forward.
 Join meetings and calls with clients, partners and agencies, taking notes and supporting follow-up.
 Help turn commercial ideas into clear proposals with pricing, positioning and next steps.
 Work across sales, marketing, events and subscriptions, adapting quickly as priorities evolve.
 Take on the practical, sometimes unglamorous work needed to help a small business grow.
 We’re looking for someone who 
 Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent early-career experience.
 Is excited by commercial work and motivated by helping ideas turn into revenue.
 Is interested in sales, marketing, partnerships, media, events or business development.
 Is highly organised and comfortable managing lists, trackers and multiple follow-ups.
 Is numerate and confident using spreadsheets.
 Is a sharp, clear writer who can communicate professionally over email and in presentations.
 Is proactive, resilient and comfortable reaching out to people they do not know.
 Is curious, resourceful and willing to learn quickly.
 Enjoys working in a small team where everyone pitches in.
 Is comfortable with both high-profile opportunities and repetitive operational work, such as researching prospects and following up on outreach.
 Has an interest in media, publishing, technology, economics, policy or culture. Previous media or publishing experience is helpful but not required.
 Working at Works in Progress 
 This role is based in London and requires working from the office every day. You will be part of a small, ambitious team that cares deeply about the magazine and its growth. In return, you will get a steep learning curve, close mentorship and the chance to contribute directly to building the commercial future of Works in Progress.

ac67da1a2100.title: Payroll Analyst - International
ac67da1a2100.location: London, United Kingdom London, United Kingdom - Deliveroo
ac67da1a2100.description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 About Deliveroo 
 At Deliveroo, our mission is to build the definitive food company. To make that possible, we’re creating an environment where everyone can belong, grow, and do their best work.
 About the Role 
 As an Italy Payroll Analyst , you will be responsible for administering and overseeing the end-to-end payroll process for our Italy population. You’ll partner closely with HR, Finance, Employment Tax, Legal and our external payroll providers to ensure accurate, compliant and timely payroll delivery.
 This is an individual contributor role requiring strong technical expertise in Italian payroll legislation, statutory compliance and employee taxation . You will act as the Italy Payroll Subject Matter Expert (SME) , ensuring robust payroll governance, maintaining high standards of accuracy and supporting continuous improvement across our Workday and CloudPay payroll ecosystem.
 You will also play an important role in identifying opportunities to simplify, automate and improve payroll processes, while supporting wider global payroll initiatives and projects.
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Lead the end-to-end Italy payroll process — from data preparation, validation and payroll inputs through to review, reconciliation and final sign-off, ensuring accurate and timely payroll delivery.
 Act as the Italy Payroll SME , providing expert guidance on Italian payroll legislation, taxation, statutory requirements and payroll best practice.
 Support other payroll entities within the team where required, contributing to the successful delivery of the wider global payroll operation.
 Oversee outsourced payroll processing with our payroll provider, CloudPay, ensuring agreed SLAs, controls and quality standards are consistently met.
 Partner cross-functionally with HR, Finance, Employment Tax and Legal to resolve payroll issues, ensure accurate data flows and deliver a seamless employee payroll experience.
 Maintain strong knowledge of Italian payroll legislation and statutory requirements , ensuring payroll processes remain compliant with regulatory changes.
 Ensure the accurate and timely processing of Italian statutory payments, contributions and filings , including social security, income tax and other applicable statutory requirements.
 Review and reconcile payroll outputs , identifying discrepancies and ensuring issues are investigated and resolved before payroll sign-off.
 Prepare and reconcile payroll journals and Finance reporting , ensuring payroll costs are accurately reflected in financial records and supporting audit requirements.
 Manage payroll controls and governance , ensuring appropriate checks are completed throughout each payroll cycle and maintaining a strong audit trail.
 Drive continuous improvement and automation , identifying opportunities to reduce manual processes, improve controls and increase payroll efficiency.
 Act as SME for CloudPay and Workday payroll processes in Italy , supporting system enhancements, integrations, testing and payroll-related projects.
 Support Workday and payroll implementation/migration projects , including requirements gathering, testing, parallel runs and go-live activities.
 Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders , proactively identifying risks and resolving payroll issues.
 Share knowledge and best practice with colleagues across the wider Payroll team, supporting a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence.
 Support regional and global payroll initiatives , ensuring Italy remains aligned with Deliveroo’s wider payroll strategy and operating model.
 Requirements 
 3+ years of progressive payroll experience , including significant experience managing Italian payroll and statutory compliance.
 Strong technical knowledge of Italian payroll legislation, employment taxation, social security and statutory requirements .
 Experience managing or overseeing outsourced payroll providers , ideally within a multinational or international organisation.
 Experience with Workday and/or CloudPay is preferred but not essential.
 Proven ability to manage the full payroll lifecycle , including payroll inputs, validation, reconciliation, sign-off and statutory reporting.
 Strong understanding of payroll controls, governance, audit requirements and data integrity.
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across HR, Finance, Tax, Legal and external vendors.
 Demonstrated ability to identify and deliver process improvements, automation and operational efficiencies .
 Experience supporting payroll system implementations, integrations, testing or transformation projects is desirable.
 Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to perform detailed payroll reconciliations, analyse large datasets and identify discrepancies.
 Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables and confidently challenge processes or data where required.
 Fluent Italian and strong English communication skills are highly desirable.
 Why Deliveroo? 
 We’re a technology-driven company transforming how the world eats — making food more accessible, faster and better. At Deliveroo, you’ll join a collaborative and dynamic environment where innovation, ownership and agility are valued.
 We also believe that great workplaces celebrate diversity and inclusivity. We welcome every background, perspective and passion — especially if you share our love for food and excellence.
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
 If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

b26f05667b14.description:
Practice Group / Department: 
 Knowledge Practice Management - London Job Description 
 Norton Rose Fulbright is a global law firm with more than 3,000 lawyers advising clients across locations in the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia, Australia, Africa and the Middle East. We provide a full scope of legal services to the world’s preeminent corporations and financial institutions.
 Our vision is to be a world class business, profitable, ambitious, cooperative and considerate, supporting our clients and people through our global business principles of Quality, Unity and Integrity.
 With over 7,000 employees worldwide, our culture is the thread that connects us. Our strategy and culture are closed connected – defined by shared ambition, global collaboration and a one-team mindset. We believe pioneering work happens when people are empowered to think beyond boundaries, explore new opportunities and grow through diverse experiences. Alongside the right skills and experience, we are looking for people who are innovative, commercially minded, and motivated by the impact of the work they do – ready to share in our ambition and help shape what comes next.
 Because while individuals can do well, together we achieve something extraordinary.
 Our London office is recruiting a Junior Knowledge Executive. We are looking for someone with relevant skills and experience who is innovative, commercially aware and takes pride in their work. 
 The Team 
 Knowledge plays an important strategic role at Norton Rose Fulbright. The team helps colleagues deliver high-quality legal services by developing legal templates and guidance, sharing expert insight and using technology to improve legal practice.
 The Junior Knowledge Executive will support the London Knowledge team, which works with colleagues and clients across EMEA. The role combines knowledge administration, training coordination and support for the team’s internal and client-facing resources.
 The role 
 The Junior Knowledge Executive will provide professional administrative support to the Knowledge team. Key responsibilities include:
 Amending legal templates, guidance notes and marketing materials, including bids and briefings, accurately and in line with the firm’s house style
 Loading and managing knowledge content in the firm’s internal knowledge database (Insight+)
 Updating knowledge intranet pages in Microsoft SharePoint or a similar web page editing platform
 Arranging travel for knowledge team members in liaison with the firm’s travel agency where required (itineraries, transport, accommodation, currency and processing expenses, etc.)
 Diary management including co-ordination and recording of knowledge team annual leave and other absences
 Using key software confidently, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Zoom and Microsoft Teams, and completing training where needed
 Coordinating in-person and virtual training across EMEA for colleagues and clients. This includes booking rooms, arranging audiovisual support, catering and printing, setting up events, managing registrations, sending reminders and working with other support teams.
 Assisting knowledge team members with the preparation of training materials and PowerPoint slides
 Editing recorded training and uploading courses to the firm’s learning management system
 Coordinating the external training course application process, including payment of invoices and managing central records
 Professional skills and approach: 
 Clarify instructions promptly where requirements or deadlines are unclear, and plan competing priorities to meet deadlines
 Support colleagues, provide cover and contribute to shared team priorities when needed
 Handle confidential client and team matters with tact, diplomacy and professionalism
 Show an active interest in the team’s work, respond constructively to queries and identify practical solutions
 Build effective working relationships with colleagues across the Knowledge team and EMEA offices
 Take a positive and committed approach, including providing support outside core hours and working arrangements when required
 undefined
 Skills and experience required: 
 English Language GCSE or equivalent
 Secretarial or administrative qualifications/ILEX secretarial certificate/diploma qualification desirable but not essential
 Confident and professional, with sound judgement and the ability to work independently when appropriate
 Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues across different teams and locations
 Keen to learn and broaden experience and responsibilities

0cbd5e749523.title: Accounts Payable Assistant
0cbd5e749523.description:
The Role 
 We are looking for an ambitious and proactive Accounts Payable Assistant to join our team in London. This is a great opportunity for someone in the early stages of their finance career who is keen to build their experience in a fast-paced, international environment and take on increasing responsibility as they develop.
 The role will primarily support the Financial Advisory business, while providing support across other geographies when required. You will work closely with colleagues across the finance function, giving you exposure to different teams, processes and systems and the opportunity to develop a broad understanding of how finance operates within an international business.
 You will be joining a supportive team where you will receive training on our internal processes and systems. We offer excellent hybrid working flexibility , with a minimum of two days per week in our London office , where you can enjoy our modern City workspace, on-site gym, barista coffee, complimentary snacks and drinks, and a brilliant social calendar .
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support the day-to-day Accounts Payable function for the Financial Advisory business.
 Process and manage invoices and AP transactions, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
 Support payments, reconciliations and invoice query resolution.
 Work across multiple finance systems and platforms, quickly building confidence in internal processes.
 Use Excel to review, reconcile and analyse financial data.
 Collaborate with finance colleagues in London and internationally, providing cross-geography support when needed.
 Take ownership of deadlines and deliverables, helping to keep finance processes running smoothly.
 Skills & Experience 
 Ideally 1–2 years’ finance experience, with exposure to Accounts Payable.
 Strong Excel skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and PivotTables.
 A good understanding of finance and accounting principles, with the ability to hit the ground running and learn quickly.
 Working towards a professional qualification such as ACCA, CIMA or AAT, or a degree in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, would be advantageous.
 Experience using finance or accounting systems; NetSuite experience would be beneficial but is not essential.
 A collaborative and flexible team player, comfortable working across teams and geographies.
 About Teneo   
 Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future. 40737d324818.description:
We see the world differently at Capstone Investment Advisors. You will, too.   
 Capstone is a global, alternative investment management firm operating across a broad range of derivatives-based strategies with a deep understanding of volatility. With approximately $14.6 billion of AUM and 315 employees (as of September 1, 2026, Capstone was formed in 2007 and is headquartered in New York with offices in London, Amsterdam, Tokyo, California, Stamford, Boston, and Milan.    
 At Capstone, we constantly aim to expand our view of how WE SEE THE WORLD DIFFERENTLY® in order to create opportunity. Our commitment to provoking the evolution of asset management provides us with a perpetual hunger for knowledge that we believe drives the improvement of our particular approach to investment. We seek to harness the complexities of global derivatives markets with disciplined strategic insight, an experienced, accomplished team and advanced technology to create sustainable value. We’ve created a particular approach to investment that we believe drives continuous improvement and opportunities for our clients, team and industry.   
 Overview:   
 The Risk Management Team is responsible for measuring, monitoring, and managing the risks of the firm. The team identifies, quantifies, evaluates, and reports the risks which result from trading strategies across all asset classes. It works closely with trading and technology teams to create and maintain tools for risk management and analytics, to make managers aware of existing and potential risks to the firm and its investors. 
 Our future colleague has these skills:   
 Current enrollment in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 Proficiency in Python and/or Java, including the ability to apply programming skills to data analysis, quantitative problem-solving, or similar technical work. 
 Familiarity with machine learning is required.
 Strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to contribute effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. 
 Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical colleagues. 
 A professional, accountable approach to work and an ability to collaborate in a manner consistent with the firm’s culture and values.   
 Do you possess these Bonus Skills:   
 Prior internship, academic, or professional experience within financial services, investment management, or a related field is preferred. 
 Intellectual curiosity, the openness to share ideas, humility, the highest ethical standards and a desire to excel are a few of the traits that it takes to thrive and be your best self at Capstone. 
 To thrive at Capstone, a keen curiosity about technology and artificial intelligence is essential, as we continually drive innovation and enhance our strategic capabilities.    
 Benefits and Compensation Information:    
 Our team is our most important asset and investment. We value and respect our colleagues and their well-being inside and outside the workplace and our culture reflects this.    
 The hourly pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis.    
 Equal Opportunity Employer:    
 Capstone is committed to creating an inclusive environment where we welcome people of different backgrounds.  Location & Travel 
 You must be a car driver for this role.

 Shopper Marketing Executive 
 Join our client's team as a Shopper Marketing Team to assist in the creation and execution of compelling in-store promotional materials that drive sales and enhance customer experience. The role requires a creative, self-motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

 * Driving further development of shopper and e-commerce initiatives.
 * Increasing engagement with trade partners.
 * Delivering market-leading shopper campaigns.
 * Developing insights via research, campaign analysis, and industry reports, translating these into actionable plans to maximise return on investment.
 Day to Day 
 * Support the development and implementation of shopper marketing plans, ensuring alignment with category vision, brand strategy, and individual retailer/channel objectives.
* Deliver best-in-class online and mobile optimisation, adhering to platform guidelines and maintaining content through platforms such as Brandbank.
* Analyse shopper and .com campaigns, gathering insights and learning's to inform future planning.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with retailer media contacts and key stakeholders.
* Identify and implement cross-category collaborations and drive brand visibility during key events.
* Work closely with agencies and third-party suppliers on shopper-focused campaigns, content creation, and delivery.
* Track competitor activity and market trends to inform strategy.
* Build an external network to bring fresh insights and ideas into the business

 Marketing degree or equivalent experience 
 Passion for in-store marketing and POS materials
 Strong communication skills and attention to detail
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365
 Ability to work to deadlines in a dynamic environment
 Customer-focused mindset with commercial awareness
 Company Benefits: 
 - Holidays: 25 days (increasing to 28 days with service).
- Additional Leave: Up to 10 extra days for long service milestones.

- Lunches & Drinks: Free lunch every day (valued at £700) + free drinks.

- Annual Flu Vaccination: Provided for all employees.

 Please ensure you are located no further than 1.5 hours drive from Romford.

At BakerHicks we deliver creative design, engineering and project delivery solutions together with our clients. Shaping a healthier, sustainable and safer world.
 Are you eager to launch your engineering career with a consultancy that embraces innovative thinking, technical curiosity, and meaningful impact? 
 From developing engineering solutions for complex, high-security sectors; to construction management, project delivery, and compliance; our multi-disciplinary design and engineering teams work alongside leading global firms to bring visionary projects to life. We are dedicated to delivering solutions that are efficient, cost-effective, and sustainable.
 If you’re a passionate Graduate ready to make a meaningful impact across diverse industries and cutting-edge projects, we’d love to have you on our team!
 About Our Graduate Programme 
 At BakerHicks we offer a dynamic two-year Graduate scheme - an exceptional launchpad for your career as a future Assistant Design Manager.
 Our program uniquely combines technical expertise with professional development through two enriching learning journeys. You'll dive into hands-on experiences alongside our industry-leading teams, equipping you with the essential skills and knowledge to thrive in your engineering career.
 From day one, you'll benefit from a personalised on-the-job training plan tailored to the HV department. This approach will not only allow you to apply your technical knowledge in real-world settings but also provide ongoing support from experienced professionals.
 You’ll actively contribute to a variety of projects, gaining invaluable experience every step of the way. We are also committed to enhancing your essential soft skills, ensuring you develop a well-rounded skill set that complements your technical abilities with effective communication, collaboration, and leadership.  
 💼 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Developing awareness and knowledge of the design lifecycle and information management standards.
 Supporting document control, drawing reviews, managing RFI’s (requests for information) and design issue logs with support from the team.
 Working with the senior design manager to proactively drive the design forward, to meet client requirements.
 Demonstrating reliability and attention to detail in checking and coordinating deliverables.
 🧠 What We’re Looking For 
 We’re looking for passionate and driven individuals who see Design Management not just as a profession, but as a calling. If you’re committed to delivering exceptional work, eager to embrace new challenges, and motivated by opportunities to grow and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. 
Our clients are at the heart of everything we do - so if you bring a proactive mindset and a positive, can-do attitude, you’ll thrive here.
 2:1 in a relevant engineering degree, such as Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical or Architectural Engineering.
 ⭐ What We Will Offer You 
 Mentorship and support towards chartership - We offer tailored mentorship and structured support to guide you through becoming professionally chartered, including access to experienced professionals for advice and coaching. You’ll build a strong portfolio, prepare for assessments, and develop key competencies while gaining hands-on experience across diverse, technically complex projects in multiple sectors.
 Exposure to high-profile and technically challenging projects - Immerse yourself in a variety of innovative, technically challenging, and high-impact projects that will sharpen and advance your skills. Our work spans multiple sectors, providing exposure to landmark designs and pioneering industry approaches.
 A friendly, supportive, and ambitious team culture – You’ll join a team that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous improvement. We foster a friendly, inclusive environment where your ideas are heard, and your growth is a shared goal. You’ll be surrounded by people who are passionate about what they do and driven to make a difference.
 📩 Shape your future with us - where your creativity, drive, and aspirations make a difference. 
 Apply now and engineer a better tomorrow! 
 Our commitment is to develop, train, and retain our graduates for the long term. Therefore, BakerHicks are unable to consider applications from candidates who are working under the Graduate visa route or other time-limited visas, regardless of their duration, due to their temporary status and the future sponsorship requirements under the Skilled Worker route, set out by the UKVI.  
 This decision follows recent changes to the Skilled Worker visa regulations introduced by the UK Government in July 2025. 
 However, we welcome applications from candidates who are eligible under alternative UK immigration routes that do not require Skilled Worker sponsorship now or at any point in the future. 
 Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels.  
 The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements. 
 In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations. 
 Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: ( National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK )  
 About BakerHicks  
 We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see: About | BakerHicks . 
 BakerHicks. A Morgan Sindall Group company.  
 Benefits  
 Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.  
 What you get will depend on what you do, with individual performance-related rewards also on offer in addition to: 
 Company car or cash allowance 
 Up to 6% matched contributory pension plan 
 Life assurance scheme 
 25 days annual leave plus ability to buy additional leave 
 Discount scheme (including gym membership, mobile phones etc) 
 Flexible/hybrid working 
 Family friendly policies 
 Employee assistance 
 Professional development 
 BakerHicks is an equal opportunity employer. We care about creating an inclusive atmosphere and are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion throughout.  
BakerHicks is an inclusive organisation welcoming talent from all backgrounds. Applicants are assessed on the basis of personal merit and qualifications.
